facts.text: I went on a solo fishing trip to a river two weeks ago.
The river fishing trip two weeks ago was a great experience despite low water level.
I am mainly interested in freshwater fishing.
I am open to traveling a bit for fishing spots.
I would love to catch trout.
I caught a smallmouth bass on my last solo fishing trip.
I prefer rivers and streams for fishing.
I am also up for lakes or ponds if they are known for good fishing.
I would like a boat launch as an amenity, but it is not necessary.
I tried out a new rod and reel combo on a trip to Lake Tahoe with my friends three weeks ago.
I plan to bring my new rod and reel combo to the mountain stream.
I plan to bring my current fishing setup to the mountain stream.
I plan to try new lures, including a curly tail grub.
The curly tail grub worked well for me last Tuesday at our local pond.
I plan to bring topwater lures as well.
Topwater lures worked well for me on my solo fishing trip to the river two weeks ago.
